database guards reject old INSERT/UPDATE, missing version mirrors and missing deferred revision audits without leaving rows
caller taskState/taskActions metadata cannot forge verification, a task version or an idempotent action receipt
source FK SET NULL preserves business revision but changes the full-row current token
foreign sources, task commands and exact task/scenario reads do not cross owner boundaries
generic snapshot writes cannot forge the reserved scenario lineage or outrank the authorized task projection, including inside a Work lease
exact typed scenario lookup remains correct beyond 100 newer unrelated snapshots
pg_locks barrier proves a current task snapshot/ref/receipt commits coherently before a competing real domain transition
valid synthetic Work/run/lease commits task history and L2, stale tokens cannot write, and a projection fault rolls back before the same command recovers
a state-read receipt insert failure rejects task/scenario current reads and leaves no successful receipt
